question: Who is National Security Advisor of India as of July 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ajit Doval**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ajit Doval** is the current **National Security Advisor (NSA) of India** as of **July 2023**.
 
• The position of NSA was established in **1998** to advise the Prime Minister on issues related to **national security and strategic interests.**
 
• **Ajit Doval** is a retired Indian Police Service (IPS) officer</str
